prs.cluster_pick_reason: PR #1617 is the broader fix: it widens the inputSchema type (ZodRawShapeCompat | AnySchema), adds the isLikelyJsonSchema guard in the schema-normalization path (line ~146), and preserves the plain schema on the wire — supporting the deprecated overload without breaking callers. PR #1596 only adds a throw in the annotations-detection branch (line ~1024), which would reject valid existing usage that #1617 explicitly aims to preserve.
